description: Non-Debuggable struct passed as the typed-attrs value is rejected. Diagnostic shape is the compact 'no matching method' form because the post-0.27.201 Logger overload set has two 2-arg candidates (typed-attrs and explicit-ctx); overload resolution gives up before any single candidate's constraint failure can surface. The intent (rejection) is preserved; diagnostic quality is a known regression — see std_log_non_debuggable_attrs_rejected note in history.md.
